info.name: Perform an operation on all sources

items.docs:
Perform operations on all sources. The following operations are supported: * `exportSources`: Export a ZIP file that contains a list of all sources in the application. * `cloneFilesIntoSource`: Clone a source's files into a different source.

params.name: replaceAllExistingSources
params.description: If `false`, adds the sources from the ZIP to the sources in the target tenant. If `true`, removes all sources in the target tenant and adds the sources from the ZIP. Default is `false`.
